emberbloom.name: Emberbloom
notes: An emberbloom, its petals glowing like coals. It is hot, but it does not burn you.
Another emberbloom. Ash settles on it and flares away in tiny sparks.

chapters.title: Ash and Ember
intro: So the sea gave you back. Few it does, on Emberfall.
I am Ysolde, Keeper of this landing. The fire under the island is waking, and everything that crawls out of the ash is angry about it.
Help me hold the landing, and I will tell you why the mountain burns.

chapters.title: The Molten Heart
intro: The blooms tell me what I feared: the caldera's guardian has woken, and it is calling the island's fire to itself.
If it is not stopped, Emberfall goes under, and the two of us with it. The way up starts at the north end of the coast.

quests.learned: The imps are not hunting: they are fleeing the heat rising from the caldera.
fieldNote: The last imp scrambles off into the ash, glancing back at the smoking mountain rather than at you.
quests.title: Hold the Landing
quests.hint: Cinder imps swarm the ash fields of The Cinder Coast, all round the landing.
offer: The imps are thick around the landing today. Drive off five of them before they get into the stores.
remind: Five imps. They are never far from the landing.
done: Good. The landing is ours again, for now.
They were running, you know. Not attacking. Something up the mountain frightens them.

quests.learned: Emberblooms only open when the mountain's fire rises close under the ground.
fieldNote: Four blooms, all burning brighter than they should. Even the ash is warm under your feet.
quests.title: Read the Blooms
quests.hint: Emberblooms glow in the ash of The Cinder Coast: by The Glass Fields in the west, the woods in the north and The Smoking Pools in the east.
offer: The emberblooms tell the mountain's mood. Touch four of them and tell me how they burn.
remind: Four emberblooms. West by the glass, north in the dead woods, east by the pools.
done: Brighter than they should be. Much brighter.
Take this draught; you will need it where you are going next.

quests.learned: The ash hounds hunt in the open now; the woods are too hot for them.
fieldNote: The fourth hound falls. Its fur is singed down to the skin.
quests.title: Hounds in the Ash
quests.hint: Ash hounds roam the open ground of The Cinder Coast. They see you before you see them.
offer: Before you climb, clear the hounds from the coast road. Four of them, and the way north is safe.
remind: Four ash hounds. Watch the open ground.
done: The road north is clear. Rest, and then the caldera.

quests.learned: The casters are feeding the lava lake, ember by ember, for their guardian.
fieldNote: The last caster's fire gutters out. The lava lake below sinks, just a little.
quests.title: Quench the Casters
quests.hint: Ember casters tend the lava lake of The Ember Caldera, north of the coast. Close in fast: they hurl fire from afar.
offer: Robed ones tend the lava in the caldera, feeding it. Stop four of them, and the guardian goes hungry.
remind: Four casters, in the caldera. Do not let them keep their distance.
done: The mountain is quieter already. One thing remains, and it is the hardest.

quests.learned: The Obsidian Warden was the island's keeper once, before the fire took its mind.
fieldNote: The Obsidian Warden kneels, and its golden plate cools to black. Far below, the lava stops rising.
quests.title: The Obsidian Warden
quests.hint: The Obsidian Warden stands on The Warden's Rim, at the far north of The Ember Caldera.
offer: The guardian waits on the far rim of the caldera. It was a keeper like me, once. Free it.
remind: The Obsidian Warden, on the rim. Mind its blade.
done: It is done. I felt the mountain sigh.
Take this blade, forged on this island long ago. It is yours by right now.

epilogue: Emberfall sleeps again, and the sea is calm for the first time in a year.
There will be a ship, one day. Until then, the landing is yours as much as mine.
